description: Source code for an Android soft keyboard implementation, including input handling, keyboard view management, and candidate suggestions.

classes.name: SoftKeyboard
classes.description: An Android input method service implementing a soft keyboard with candidate suggestions and multiple keyboard layouts.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the input method, sets up system services and word separators.

methods.name: getDisplayContext
methods.description: Returns a context adjusted for display metrics, supporting multi-display scenarios.

methods.name: onInitializeInterface
methods.description: Initializes keyboard layouts based on display metrics.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates and returns the input view (keyboard layout).

methods.name: setLatinKeyboard
methods.description: Sets the current keyboard layout and updates language switch key visibility.

methods.name: onCreateCandidatesView
methods.description: Creates and returns the candidate view for suggestions.

methods.name: onStartInput
methods.description: Prepares the keyboard state based on the type of text being edited.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Resets the keyboard state when input is finished.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Applies the current keyboard layout when input view starts.

methods.name: onCurrentInputMethodSubtypeChanged
methods.description: Updates space key subtype when input method subtype changes.

methods.name: onUpdateSelection
methods.description: Clears composing text if cursor position changes.

methods.name: onDisplayCompletions
methods.description: Displays candidate completions if available.

methods.name: translateKeyDown
methods.description: Translates hard key events into text input.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, including back, delete, enter, and hard keys.

methods.name: onKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events, updating meta key states.

methods.name: commitTyped
methods.description: Commits current composing text to the input connection.

methods.name: updateShiftKeyState
methods.description: Updates shift state based on editor info.

methods.name: isAlphabet
methods.description: Checks if a character code is alphabetic.

methods.name: keyDownUp
methods.description: Sends a key down/up event sequence.

methods.name: sendKey
methods.description: Sends a character or key code to the input connection.

methods.name: onKey
methods.description: Handles key press events from the keyboard view.

methods.name: onText
methods.description: Handles text input from the keyboard view.

methods.name: updateCandidates
methods.description: Updates candidate suggestions based on current composing text.

methods.name: setSuggestions
methods.description: Sets candidate suggestions in the candidate view.

methods.name: handleBackspace
methods.description: Handles backspace key, deleting or updating composing text.

methods.name: handleShift
methods.description: Toggles shift/caps lock state.

methods.name: handleCharacter
methods.description: Handles character input, updating composing text or committing directly.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the input method.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the window token for the input method.

methods.name: handleLanguageSwitch
methods.description: Switches to the next input method.

methods.name: checkToggleCapsLock
methods.description: Toggles caps lock if shift is pressed twice quickly.

methods.name: getWordSeparators
methods.description: Returns the string of word separator characters.

methods.name: isWordSeparator
methods.description: Checks if a character code is a word separator.

methods.name: pickDefaultCandidate
methods.description: Selects the first candidate suggestion.

methods.name: pickSuggestionManually
methods.description: Selects a candidate suggestion by index.

methods.name: swipeRight
methods.description: Handles swipe right gesture to select candidate.

methods.name: swipeLeft
methods.description: Handles swipe left gesture to delete.

methods.name: swipeDown
methods.description: Handles swipe down gesture to close keyboard.

methods.name: swipeUp
methods.description: Handles swipe up gesture (no implementation).

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Handles key press event (no implementation).

methods.name: onRelease
methods.description: Handles key release event (no implementation).
